title: banner frame settings
description: Settings for the banner frame type (epic web zones R3). A missing field takes its default.

variant.title: Variant
variant.description: How the slides are shown. carousel: one slide at a time, the default look. coverflow: the current slide in front, its neighbours turned away at the sides. peek: the neighbours show at the edges. deck: the slides fanned out like cards. sticky: the banner stays on screen while the page scrolls. strip: a continuous marquee of the slides. autoplay, loop, showDots and aspectRatio apply to carousel, coverflow, peek and deck; sticky and strip ignore aspectRatio, showDots and loop; strip also ignores autoplay and intervalSeconds, since it scrolls at a fixed speed.

autoplay.title: Autoplay
autoplay.description: Move to the next slide by itself. It stops when the visitor interacts with the banner or prefers reduced motion.

intervalSeconds.title: Interval
intervalSeconds.description: Seconds each slide shows while autoplaying, from 3 to 15.

showDots.title: Show dots
showDots.description: Show a dot per slide to jump to it.

loop.title: Loop
loop.description: After the last slide, go back to the first.
